title: Explanations that Transfer: Interpreting Medical Retrieval with Sparse AutoEncoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.18179v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical AI systems that answer users' queries rely on retrieving medical knowledge from large document collections. In this context, finetuning general models on medical datasets can improve retrieval relevance. Yet the dense embeddings underlying modern retrieval systems remain largely opaque, making it difficult to understand the mechanics behind their results. Moreover, adapting to a specific medical dataset risks losing transferability to new clinical corpora. In this work, we tackle these issues by applying Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to medical information retrieval, transforming dense text embeddings into semantically interpretable representations. To do so, our model combines a reconstruction objective with an InfoNCE contrastive loss that directly preserves query-document relevance. translated_abstract: 回答用户查询的医学AI系统依赖于从大型文档集合中检索医学知识。在此背景下，在医学数据集上微调通用模型可以提升检索相关性。然而，现代检索系统所依赖的稠密嵌入在很大程度上仍是不透明的，难以理解其检索结果背后的机制。此外，针对特定医学数据集进行适配可能会失去对新临床语料库的可迁移性。在本工作中，我们通过将稀疏自编码器（SAEs）应用于医学信息检索来解决这些问题，将稠密文本嵌入转化为语义上可解释的表示。为此，我们的模型将重建目标与InfoNCE对比损失相结合，后者能够直接保留查询与文档之间的相关性。我们在六个医学检索数据集上（涵盖域内与域外场景）评估了三种嵌入模型。在医学语料库上训练后，我们的稀疏……
tldr: 本文提出将稀疏自编码器应用于医学信息检索，通过结合重建目标与InfoNCE对比损失，将不透明的稠密文本嵌入转化为语义可解释的表示，同时保持对新临床语料库的可迁移性。
en_tdlr: This work applies Sparse Autoencoders to medical information retrieval, combining a reconstruction objective with an InfoNCE contrastive loss to transform opaque dense text embeddings into interpretable semantic representations while preserving transferability to new clinical corpora.
